grades.quote: `FMOV{S/D}` writes the value of the floating-point register `fj` into the floating-point register `fd` in the singleprecision/double-precision floating-point number format.
grades.reason: Describes a raw-bit move, but only between two floating-point registers (fj to fd). It does not move bits between integer and FP registers, so it helps only as auxiliary context.

grades.quote: For RV32 only, if the D extension is implemented, the FMVH.X.D instruction moves bits 63:32 of floating-point register _rs1_ into integer register _rd_ .
grades.reason: Describes RISC-V Zfa instructions that move raw bits between integer and floating-point registers: FMVH.X.D and FMVP.D.X for RV32, and FMVH.X.Q and FMVP.Q.X for RV64. It covers only the pair and high-half moves, not the base FMV.X.W/FMV.W.X, so it is a useful part of the answer.
